节点.曲线沿方向平行投影到平面（精确，不需要内核）或实体 / 曲面上（经实体内核，可能: Projects a curve along a direction onto a plane (exact, no kernel needed) or onto a solid / surface (through the solid kernel; may give several curves)
节点.不接时：投影到平面沿平面法向，投影到实体 / 曲面沿 −Z: If not connected: along the plane normal for a plane, along −Z for a solid / surface
节点.用给定的控制点数与阶数重新逼近曲线（两端点不变，最小二乘），给出最大偏差；曲线实: Refits a curve with the given number of control points and degree (end points kept, least squares) and reports the largest deviation; curve entities are converted
节点.从起点经过中间点到终点的圆弧（三点在同一水平面上）: Arc from the start through the middle point to the end (the three points in one horizontal plane)
节点.平面上以原点为中心、沿平面 X / Y 轴的两个半径的椭圆（精确的有理 NURB: Ellipse centered on the plane origin with radii along the plane X / Y axes (an exact rational NURBS 3D curve)
节点.曲线的起点与终点；曲线实体自动转换: Start and end points of a curve; curve entities are converted
节点.是否闭合、是否在一个平面上（按控制点判断）、阶数与控制点: Whether the curve is closed and planar (judged by control points), its degree and control points
节点.曲线上离给定点最近的点、参数 t（0～1，同“曲线取点”）与距离: The point on a curve nearest to a given point, its parameter t (0–1, as in “Point on Curve”) and the distance
节点.两条曲线的交点（空间曲线按距离容差判断相交）与各自的参数 t（0～1）；重合的部: Intersection points of two curves (3D curves intersect within the distance tolerance) and the parameters t (0–1) on each; overlaps are ignored
节点.曲线穿过平面的点与参数 t（0～1）；曲线落在平面内的部分不计: Points where a curve crosses a plane and their parameters t (0–1); parts lying in the plane are ignored
节点.读取图纸里的点对象；先在绘图区选择，再点节点上的“用选择集设置”。图纸改动后自动: Reads point objects from the drawing: select them in the drawing area, then click “Set from Selection” on the node. Recomputes when the drawing changes
节点.读取图纸里的三维实体（含位置），可以作为布尔运算、剪切的输入；图纸改动后自动重算: Reads 3D solids (with their placement) from the drawing, for use in Boolean operations or cutting. Recomputes when the drawing changes
节点.以平面原点为基点，沿平面 X / Y / Z 轴分别缩放；曲线变为空间曲线: Scales separately along the plane X / Y / Z axes about the plane origin; curves become 3D curves
节点.把源平面上的几何搬到目标平面上（如把 XY 上画的轮廓放到任意工作平面）；离开水: Moves geometry from the source plane to the target plane (such as placing a profile drawn on XY onto any work plane); curves leaving the horizontal plane become 3D curves
节点.按 X、Y 两个方向的间距复制成行列（含原件，先沿 X）: Copies into rows and columns by the X and Y spacings (original included, X first)
节点.沿曲线按弧长等距复制（原件视为放在曲线起点）；“沿切线定向”时随曲线方向转动，否: Copies at equal arc-length steps along a curve (the original counts as placed at the curve start); with “Align to tangent” the copies turn with the curve, otherwise they are only moved. No duplicate at the ends of a closed curve
节点.A 除以 B 的余数（结果与 B 同号，如 −1 取余 3 为 2）: Remainder of A divided by B (same sign as B; −1 mod 3 is 2)
节点.四舍五入（0.5 远离 0）、向下或向上取整: Rounds to nearest (0.5 away from 0), down or up
节点.点 (X, Y) 的方位角，结果为度（−180～180）: Direction angle of the point (X, Y) in degrees (−180 to 180)
节点.π、e、黄金比 φ、√2，乘以系数: π, e, the golden ratio φ or √2, times a factor
节点.按公式计算，变量为 a、b、c、d 以及“参数”节点的名称；语法同 Revit: Evaluates a formula with the variables a, b, c, d and the names of “Parameter” nodes; same syntax as Revit formulas: + − × ÷ ^ %, comparisons, if(condition, true, false), sin / cos / tan (degrees), sqrt, abs, round, roundup, rounddown, min, max, pi
节点.比较 A 与 B（相差不超过 1e−9 视为相等）: Compares A and B (a difference up to 1e−9 counts as equal)
节点.条件为真时输出“真”，否则输出“假”（任何类型）: Outputs “True” when the condition is true, otherwise “False” (any type)
节点.由起点、终点构造区间: Builds a domain from its start and end
节点.区间的起点、终点与长度（终点 − 起点）: Start, end and length (end − start) of a domain
节点.把数值从源区间按比例映射到目标区间（不截断）: Maps a number proportionally from the source domain to the target domain (not clamped)
节点.从起点（0 起，负数从末尾数）取若干项；数量为负时取到末尾: Takes a number of items from the start index (from 0; negative counts from the end); a negative count takes to the end
节点.按键从小到大排序；接了“值”时值按同样的顺序排列（两个列表要一样长）: Sorts keys in ascending order; connected “Values” are arranged in the same order (both lists must be the same length)
节点.模式为真的项保留、为假的剔除；模式比列表短时循环使用: Keeps items where the pattern is true and removes those where it is false; a shorter pattern repeats
节点.整体向前移动若干位（偏移 1：第 1 项变成第 0 项）；循环时移出的项接到末尾: Shifts the whole list forward (offset 1: item 1 becomes item 0); with Wrap the shifted-out items go to the end, otherwise they are dropped
节点.A、B 两两组合（笛卡尔积，A 在外层）：输出的 A、B 各有 |A| × |B: Every combination of A and B (Cartesian product, A outer): the A and B outputs each have |A| × |B| items that match item by item downstream
节点.从 A 指向 B 的向量（B − A）: Vector from A to B (B − A)
节点.A × B（垂直于两者，右手定则）: A × B (perpendicular to both, right-hand rule)
节点.两个向量之间的角度（0～180 度）: Angle between two vectors (0 to 180 degrees)
节点.过原点的 XY（法向 +Z）、YZ（法向 +X）或 XZ（法向 −Y）平面，可沿: The XY (normal +Z), YZ (normal +X) or XZ (normal −Y) plane through the origin, optionally offset along the normal
节点.由原点和法向构造平面；给出 X 轴时按它定向（投影到平面内），否则自动取水平方向: Builds a plane from an origin and a normal; a given X axis sets its orientation (projected into the plane), otherwise a horizontal direction is chosen
节点.原点 A，X 轴指向 B，C 在平面内 Y 轴一侧: Origin A, X axis toward B, C on the Y side within the plane
节点.平面的原点与 X、Y、Z（法向）轴: Origin and X, Y, Z (normal) axes of a plane
节点.沿法向平移平面: Moves a plane along its normal
节点.平面内坐标 (X, Y, Z) → 世界坐标的点（Z 沿法向）: Plane coordinates (X, Y, Z) → world point (Z along the normal)
节点.世界坐标的点 → 平面内坐标 (X, Y, Z)（Z 为到平面的有向距离）: World point → plane coordinates (X, Y, Z) (Z is the signed distance to the plane)
节点.输出空心形体：只用来切除实心（形体合并、剪切几何），预览为橙色线框，不烘焙: Outputs a void form: used only to cut solids (Combine Forms, Cut Geometry); previewed as an orange wireframe and not baked
节点.轮廓按 XY 坐标画，再放到这个平面上（默认世界 XY）: The profile is drawn in XY coordinates and placed on this plane (world XY by default)
节点.闭合轮廓（圆、椭圆、闭合样条、多段线、矩形；不闭合的多段线首尾相连）沿工作平面法: Extrudes a closed profile (circle, ellipse, closed spline, polyline, rectangle; an open polyline is closed) along the work plane normal from start to end; reversed when the end is below the start
节点.底部轮廓与顶部轮廓之间过渡（直纹）；顶部轮廓画在 XY 上、放在底部轮廓之上“高: Transition (ruled) between a base and a top profile; the top profile is drawn on XY and placed “Height” above the base
节点.闭合轮廓绕轴从起始角度旋转到结束角度（度，范围 360 为整圈）；轴不能穿过轮廓: Revolves a closed profile about an axis from the start angle to the end angle (degrees; a 360 range is a full turn); the axis must not cross the profile
节点.直线（如引用曲线选中的线）：接上时代替轴点、轴方向，方向为起点 → 终点: A line (such as one picked with Reference Curves): when connected it replaces the axis point and direction, pointing from start to end
节点.闭合轮廓（XY 上画，中心对准路径起点、与路径垂直）沿路径扫掠；路径可以是水平曲: Sweeps a closed profile (drawn on XY, centered on the path start and perpendicular to the path) along a path; the path can be a horizontal curve or a 3D curve
节点.轮廓绕自身中心转动的角度（度）: Angle by which the profile turns about its center (degrees)
节点.沿路径从起点轮廓过渡到终点轮廓（轮廓都在 XY 上画）；路径为直线时精确，曲线路: Transition along a path from the start profile to the end profile (both drawn on XY); exact for a straight path, approximated with 9 sections along a curved path
节点.底面中心、底面半径、顶面半径（0 为尖顶，否则为圆台）、高度（沿 +Z）: Base center, base radius, top radius (0 for a point, otherwise a frustum) and height (along +Z)
节点.中心、主半径、截面半径（轴沿 +Z）: Center, major radius, minor radius (axis along +Z)
节点.一组形体：全部实心求并，再减去全部空心（Revit 族里形体的默认组合方式）: A set of forms: unites all solids, then subtracts all voids (the default way forms combine in a Revit family)
节点.被切实体逐个减去全部切除体（实心或空心都可以）；可以切图纸里引用的实体（烘焙时生: Subtracts every cutter (solid or void) from the target solid in turn; can cut solids referenced from the drawing (baking makes new solids and leaves the originals)
节点.用平面把实体切成两部分：平面法向所指的一侧与另一侧（某一侧没有实体时该输出为空）: Cuts a solid in two with a plane: the side the plane normal points to and the other side (an output is empty when nothing is on that side)
节点.平面法向一侧: Side the plane normal points to
节点.封闭实体向内留下给定厚度的壳；“开口面”为去掉的面的序号（见“曲面信息”的面数）: Hollows a closed solid, leaving a shell of the given thickness inward; “Open faces” are the indices of faces to remove (see the face count in “Surface Info”); if not connected you get a closed cavity
节点.设置形体的角色：空心只用来切除实心（形体合并、剪切几何），预览为橙色线框、不烘焙: Sets the role of a form: a void is used only to cut solids (Combine Forms, Cut Geometry), previewed as an orange wireframe and not baked
节点.从起始角逆时针到终止角的圆弧（角度为度）: Arc counterclockwise from the start angle to the end angle (degrees)
节点.以中心点、宽、高给出的闭合矩形，可倒圆角: Closed rectangle from a center point, width and height, optionally filleted
节点.外接圆半径给出的正多边形: Regular polygon by its circumscribed radius
节点.依次连接点列表（同一水平面才能拉伸）: Connects a list of points in order (must be in one horizontal plane to extrude)
节点.按长度等分曲线，输出分点（闭合曲线不重复终点）: Divides a curve into equal lengths and outputs the division points (no repeated end point on a closed curve)
节点.读取图纸里的直线、圆弧、圆、椭圆、多段线、矩形、样条；先在绘图区选择，再点节点上: Reads lines, arcs, circles, ellipses, polylines, rectangles and splines from the drawing: select them in the drawing area, then click “Set from Selection” on the node. Recomputes when the drawing changes
节点.沿向量平移点、曲线或实体: Moves points, curves or solids along a vector
节点.绕过中心的轴旋转（角度为度，右手定则）；轴选“自定义”时用“轴方向”。曲线绕水平: Rotates about an axis through the center (degrees, right-hand rule); with axis “Custom” the “Axis direction” is used. Curves rotated out of the horizontal plane about a horizontal axis become 3D curves
节点.以水平面内过 A、B 两点的直线为镜像线: Mirrors about the line through points A and B in the horizontal plane
节点.沿方向向量等距复制（含原件）: Copies at equal steps along the direction vector (original included)
节点.绕中心的 Z 轴均布复制（含原件）；总角度 360° 时首尾不重复: Copies evenly about the Z axis through the center (original included); no duplicate at the ends when the total angle is 360°
节点.拖动滑条改变数值；范围与小数位可调: Drag the slider to change the number; range and decimal places are adjustable
节点.拖动滑条改变整数: Drag the slider to change the integer
节点.单击切换真 / 假: Click to switch between true and false
节点.命名参数（Revit 族参数）：名称在图内唯一，可以填公式引用其他参数（语法同“: A named parameter (like a Revit family parameter): the name is unique in the graph and can take a formula that refers to other parameters (same syntax as “Expression”; “Value” is ignored when there is a formula); “Expression” nodes can use parameter names directly. All parameters and types are edited together in the panel's “Parameters” table
节点.按类别：长度 / 角度 / 数值为数值，整数为整数，是否为布尔: By category: Length / Angle / Number give a number, Integer an integer, Yes/No a Boolean
节点.显示接入的数据；没有接入时输出自己的文字: Shows the connected data; outputs its own text when nothing is connected
节点.A 的 B 次方: A to the power of B
节点.A、B 中较小的: The smaller of A and B
节点.A、B 中较大的: The larger of A and B
节点.把起点到终点等分为 N 段，输出 N + 1 个数: Divides start to end into N equal steps and outputs N + 1 numbers
节点.起始值开始，按步长输出若干个数: Outputs a number of values from the start value in steps
节点.按种子生成可重复的随机数: Repeatable random numbers from a seed
节点.列表中所有数值之和: Sum of all numbers in the list
节点.由 X、Y、Z 构造点（向量）: Builds a point (vector) from X, Y, Z
节点.点（向量）的 X、Y、Z: X, Y, Z of a point (vector)
节点.沿 X / Y / Z 轴、长度为系数的向量: Vector along the X / Y / Z axis whose length is the factor
节点.A、B 两点间的距离: Distance between points A and B
节点.从原点起沿 X、Y 方向等间距排列的点（先 X 后 Y）: Points evenly spaced along X and Y from the origin (X first, then Y)
节点.把 A、B 两个列表首尾相接: Joins lists A and B end to end
节点.按索引（0 起）取列表中的项；负数从末尾数: Gets the item at an index (from 0); negative counts from the end
节点.列表中的项数: Number of items in the list
节点.整个列表重复若干次: Repeats the whole list a number of times
节点.以中心与三个方向的边长定义的封闭网格长方体，每条边分成给定段数: Closed mesh box from a center and three edge lengths, each edge divided into the given number of segments
节点.经纬划分的封闭网格球：经向（绕 Z 轴）与纬向段数: Closed latitude-longitude mesh sphere: segments around the Z axis and from pole to pole
节点.平面上以原点为中心的矩形网格，沿平面 X / Y 轴分成给定格数（每格两个三角形: Rectangular mesh centered on the plane origin, divided along the plane X / Y axes into the given number of cells (two triangles each)
节点.由顶点与面索引（从 0 起，每个面 3 个或 4 个）构造网格；四边形拆成两个三: Builds a mesh from vertices and face indices (from 0, 3 or 4 per face); quads are split into two triangles, counterclockwise vertices face front
节点.点集投影到平面上做 Delaunay 三角化（顶点保持原位置），结果覆盖点集的凸: Delaunay triangulation of points projected onto a plane (vertices keep their positions); the result covers the convex hull; duplicate points are merged
节点.三角化（点可能全部共线）: Delaunay mesh (the points may all be collinear)
节点.平面上的闭合曲线围成的区域三角化（耳切法），洞为内部的闭合曲线；曲线按显示精度采: Triangulates the region bounded by closed planar curves (ear clipping), with inner closed curves as holes; curves are sampled at display precision
节点.距离在容差内的顶点合并为一个（去掉退化的三角形），重算顶点法线；容差为 0 时取: Merges vertices within the tolerance (removing degenerate triangles) and recomputes vertex normals; a tolerance of 0 means one billionth of the mesh size
节点.三角形反向（正面与背面互换），法线取反: Reverses the triangles (front and back swap) and flips the normals
节点.多个网格合成一个（顶点不焊接，需要时再接“焊接”）: Combines several meshes into one (vertices are not welded; add “Weld” if needed)
节点.按共用顶点连通的三角形分成几块（不相连的部分各成一个网格）: Splits into pieces of triangles connected through shared vertices (each disconnected part becomes a mesh)
节点.Loop 细分：每次每个三角形变成 4 个，顶点按 Loop 规则平滑（边界按三: Loop subdivision: each pass turns every triangle into 4 and smooths vertices by the Loop rules (boundaries by the cubic B-spline rule)
节点.Laplacian 平滑：每次每个顶点向相邻顶点的平均位置移动“系数”（0～1）: Laplacian smoothing: each pass moves every vertex toward the average of its neighbors by “Factor” (0–1); boundary vertices can be locked
节点.边折叠（二次误差度量）减少面数到目标以下，边界形状尽量保持；会翻转三角形或破坏流: Edge collapse (quadric error metric) reduces the face count below the target while keeping the boundary shape; collapses that would flip triangles or break the manifold are skipped, so the target may not be reached
节点.实体 / 曲面离散成网格（同一位置的顶点焊接）：角度为相邻三角形法线的最大夹角，: Turns a solid / surface into a mesh (vertices at the same position welded): Angle is the largest angle between neighboring triangle normals, Chord height the largest distance from a triangle to the true surface (0 for no limit). A solid / surface connected straight to a mesh input is meshed at the default precision (15°)
节点.每个三角形一个平面面并缝合：封闭网格得到多面实体（可布尔），开放网格得到多面曲面: One planar face per triangle, sewn together: a closed mesh gives a faceted solid (usable in Booleans), an open mesh a faceted surface (can be thickened). Slow with many faces
节点.网格的顶点、面索引（每 3 个一个三角形，从 0 起）与各面的单位法线: Vertices, face indices (3 per triangle, from 0) and the unit normal of each face
节点.网格的边连成折线（空间曲线）：边界（只属于一个面的边，即开口的轮廓）、折边（两侧: Joins mesh edges into polylines (3D curves): Boundary (edges of only one face, the open outline), Creases (edges whose faces meet at more than “Angle”, boundary included) or All. Adjacency is by shared vertices, so “Weld” an unwelded mesh first
节点.折边：两侧面法线的夹角下限（度）: Creases: smallest angle between the normals of the two faces (degrees)
节点.沿“方向”看网格时的轮廓：两侧面一个朝向、一个背向观察者的边，以及边界边，连成折: Outline of the mesh seen along “Direction”: edges between a face toward and a face away from the viewer, plus boundary edges, joined into polylines (left in place; add “Project” for a plan drawing)
节点.顶点数、面数、是否封闭（每条边恰好被两个面反向共用）、面积与体积（只对封闭网格有: Vertex count, face count, whether it is closed (every edge shared by exactly two faces in opposite directions), area and volume (only meaningful for a closed mesh, otherwise 0)
节点.网格上离给定点最近的点、距离与所在面的序号: The point on a mesh nearest to a given point, the distance and the face index
节点.网格与平面（沿法向偏移“高度”）的截交线（折线）：水平截面另外输出曲线（多段线）: Section of a mesh with a plane (offset “Height” along its normal) as polylines; a horizontal section also outputs curves (polylines), like the solid “Section”
节点.截平面沿平面法向的偏移: Offset of the section plane along its normal
节点.水平截面的多段线（截平面不水平时为空）: Polylines of a horizontal section (empty when the plane is not horizontal)
节点.网格 A 与 B 求交：B 为网格时输出交线，为曲线 / 空间曲线时输出交点（曲: Intersects mesh A with B: a mesh B gives intersection lines, a curve / 3D curve gives points (curves sampled at display precision), a plane works like “Mesh Section”; a solid / surface B is meshed at the default precision first (kernel needed)
节点.网格、曲线、空间曲线、平面或实体 / 曲面: Mesh, curve, 3D curve, plane or solid / surface
节点.以基点和三个边长给出的长方体；“居中”时基点为底面中心: A box from a base point and three edge lengths; with “Centered” the base point is the center of the bottom face
节点.列表中所有实体合并为一个: Unites all solids in the list into one
节点.A 减去 B 列表中的全部实体: Subtracts every solid in list B from A
节点.列表中所有实体的公共部分: The part common to all solids in the list
节点.对实体的边倒角；“边”为边的编号（见“实体信息”的边数），不接时处理全部边: Chamfers solid edges; “Edges” are edge indices (see the edge count in “Solid Info”); if not connected all edges are chamfered
节点.对实体的边倒圆角；“边”为边的编号（见“实体信息”的边数），不接时处理全部边: Fillets solid edges; “Edges” are edge indices (see the edge count in “Solid Info”); if not connected all edges are filleted
节点.体积、边数、包围盒；开放曲面没有体积（输出 0 并提示，面积见“曲面信息”）: Volume, edge count and bounding box; an open surface has no volume (outputs 0 with a warning; see “Surface Info” for area)
节点.实体与平面（沿法向偏移“高度”）的截交线：水平截面输出曲线（多段线），任意平面输: Section of a solid with a plane (offset “Height” along its normal): a horizontal section outputs curves (polylines), any other plane outputs 3D curves (polylines)
节点.依次经过全部点的光滑空间曲线（三次 NURBS，至少 3 个点）；“闭合”时首尾: Smooth 3D curve through all points in order (cubic NURBS, at least 3 points); “Closed” joins the ends smoothly
节点.逼近全部点的光滑曲线（不一定经过各点）；各点到曲线的距离不超过容差，容差为 0: Smooth curve approximating all points (not necessarily through them); every point is within the tolerance, a tolerance of 0 means 1/1000 of the point set size
节点.以点列表为控制点的 NURBS 曲线（两端经过首末点）；点数不够时阶数自动降低。: NURBS curve with the points as control points (through the first and last points); the degree drops when there are too few points. No solid kernel needed
节点.轴沿 +Z 过基点的螺旋线，起点在基点 + (底部半径, 0, 0)；顶部半径不: Helix with its axis along +Z through the base point, starting at base point + (bottom radius, 0, 0); a different top radius gives a conical helix
节点.空间曲线上参数 t（0～1，按参数而不是按长度）处的点与单位切线；曲线实体自动转: Point and unit tangent at parameter t (0–1, by parameter rather than length) on a 3D curve; curve entities are converted
节点.共面的闭合曲线围成的平面曲面；被包含的曲线为洞（如同心圆得到圆环面）: Planar surface bounded by coplanar closed curves; enclosed curves are holes (concentric circles give an annulus)
节点.曲线沿向量平移扫过的开放曲面（不封口；闭合曲线得到筒状曲面，封闭实体用“实体/拉: Open surface swept by moving a curve along a vector (not capped; a closed curve gives a tube; use “Solid/Extrusion” for a closed solid)
节点.曲线（可以不闭合）绕轴旋转形成的曲面；角度为度，右手定则，360 为整圈: Surface formed by revolving a curve (may be open) about an axis; degrees, right-hand rule, 360 is a full turn
节点.依次经过各截面曲线的曲面（至少 2 条；截面方向要一致）。“直纹”时相邻截面之间: Surface through the section curves in order (at least 2, all running the same way). “Ruled” makes ruled surfaces between neighboring sections, “Closed” connects the last section back to the first; closed sections give an uncapped tube, which can then be thickened or capped
节点.两条曲线对应点之间连直线形成的曲面: Surface made of straight lines between corresponding points of two curves
节点.截面沿轨道扫过的开放曲面，截面随轨道转动；截面的起点应在轨道的起点上: Open surface swept by a section along a rail, turning with the rail; the section should start at the start of the rail
节点.截面的两端沿两条轨道滑动形成的曲面：截面的起点在轨道 1 的起点、终点在轨道 2: Surface formed by the ends of a section sliding along two rails: the section starts at the start of rail 1 and ends at the start of rail 2, scaling with the gap between them; with two sections (the second at the rail ends) it blends along the rails. Exact for straight rails, approximated by lofting 12 sections along curved rails
节点.圆截面沿空间曲线扫掠（如螺旋线 → 弹簧）；“封口”时两端封闭成实体: Sweeps a circular section along a 3D curve (a helix gives a spring); “Cap” closes both ends into a solid
节点.2～4 条首尾相接的边围成的曲面（Coons）；2 条时为两条曲线之间的直纹面，: Surface bounded by 2 to 4 edges joined end to end (Coons); with 2 edges it is a ruled surface between them, with 3 the fourth edge shrinks to a point
节点.经过两组交叉曲线的曲面（Gordon）：U 向、V 向各至少 2 条，同一组曲线: Surface through two sets of crossing curves (Gordon): at least 2 in each of U and V, curves in a set running the same way and each crossing every curve of the other set
节点.经过点阵中全部点的曲面：点按行排列（先 X 后 Y，同“点阵”节点），每行“列数: Surface through every point of a grid: points in rows (X first, then Y, as from the “Point Grid” node), “Columns” points per row; at least 2 rows and 2 columns
节点.逼近散乱点的光滑曲面（最小二乘，不一定经过各点；点投影到最佳平面上分配参数，不能: Smooth surface approximating scattered points (least squares, not necessarily through them; parameters come from projecting onto the best-fit plane, so the cloud must not be closed or folded)
节点.按 x(u, v)、y(u, v)、z(u, v) 三个公式（语法同“表达式”，: Samples the three formulas x(u, v), y(u, v), z(u, v) (same syntax as “Expression”, trigonometry in degrees, parameter names allowed) over the U / V domains and makes a surface through those points
节点.开放曲面沿法线（“曲面取点”的法线方向）偏移；距离为负时反向: Offsets an open surface along its normal (the normal of “Point on Surface”); a negative distance reverses it
节点.开放曲面沿法线方向加厚成实体（厚度为负时反向），侧边封闭: Thickens an open surface along its normal into a solid (negative thickness reverses it), with the sides closed
节点.翻转单个面的曲面的法线方向（影响偏移、加厚的方向）；修剪过的面暂不支持: Flips the normal of a single-face surface (affects the offset and thicken direction); trimmed faces are not supported yet
节点.单个面的曲面向四周各延伸给定距离（线性延伸）；修剪过的面暂不支持: Extends a single-face surface by the given distance on every side (linear extension); trimmed faces are not supported yet
节点.切割曲线沿“方向”投影到曲面上把曲面切开，保留“保留点”所在的一侧（保留点取最近: Projects the cutting curve onto the surface along “Direction” and cuts it, keeping the side with the “Keep point” (the side nearest to it)
节点.切割曲线沿“方向”投影到曲面上，把曲面切成几块（按面输出）: Projects the cutting curves onto the surface along “Direction” and cuts it into pieces (one output per face)
节点.一组曲面按容差缝合成一个多重曲面；围成封闭体积时得到实体（之后可以布尔）: Sews surfaces into one polysurface within the tolerance; a closed volume gives a solid (usable in Booleans)
节点.曲面的平面开口补上平面面（如管状曲面两端）；开口全部补上时得到实体。非平面开口可: Fills planar openings of a surface with planar faces (such as the ends of a tube); when every opening is filled you get a solid. Fill non-planar openings with “Edge Surface” and then “Join Surfaces”
节点.实体或多重曲面的每个面成为一个单独的曲面: Makes every face of a solid or polysurface a separate surface
节点.用给定的控制点数重新逼近单个面的曲面（三次），使曲面更光顺或更简单；修剪过的面暂: Refits a single-face surface with the given numbers of control points (cubic) to make it smoother or simpler; trimmed faces are not supported yet
节点.曲面上参数 (U, V)（各 0～1）处的点与单位法线；“面”为面的序号（见“曲: Point and unit normal at parameters (U, V) (each 0–1) on a surface; “Face” is the face index (see the face count in “Surface Info”)
节点.面积、面数，以及是否为封闭实体（开放曲面没有体积）: Area, face count and whether it is a closed solid (an open surface has no volume)
节点.实体或曲面的面（单个曲面）、边（精确的空间曲线，顺序同边编号）与顶点: Faces (single surfaces), edges (exact 3D curves in edge-index order) and vertices of a solid or surface
节点.面上参数 t（0～1）处的等参线：U 向为 V 固定、U 变化的曲线，V 向反之: Isocurve at parameter t (0–1) on a face: U runs along U with V fixed, V the other way round (on the whole underlying surface, ignoring trims)
节点.实体或曲面（修剪后的面）上离给定点最近的点与距离: The point on a solid or surface (trimmed faces) nearest to a given point, and the distance
节点.A（曲面或实体）与 B 求交：B 为曲线时输出交点，B 为曲面 / 实体时输出交: Intersects A (surface or solid) with B: a curve B gives points, a surface / solid B gives intersection curves; empty when they do not meet. Method “Exact” uses the kernel, falling back to a mesh approximation with a warning when the kernel finds nothing but the meshes intersect; “Mesh approximation” intersects fine meshes directly (polyline results)
节点.曲面上 (U, V) 处的高斯曲率、平均曲率与两个主曲率（符号按“曲面取点”的法: Gaussian curvature, mean curvature and the two principal curvatures at (U, V) on a surface (signs follow the “Point on Surface” normal: bending toward the normal is positive)
节点.组的输入端口：组实例上对应输入收到的数据从这里输出，实例上没有数据时输出“默认”: An input of the group: outputs the data received by the matching input of the group instance, or “Default” when the instance has none. The port is named by “Name” and ordered top to bottom on the canvas
节点.组实例的这个输入没有数据时输出的值: Value output when this input of the group instance has no data
节点.组的输出端口：连到这里的数据成为组实例上对应输出的数据。端口名称取“名称”，顺序: An output of the group: data connected here becomes the matching output of the group instance. The port is named by “Name” and ordered top to bottom on the canvas
